title: UPI free hai, toh paisa kaun kamata hai?
topic: UPI zero MDR economics: who pays for the rails, government subsidy, and the MDR on large merchant payments
caption:
UPI free hai, toh bill kaun bharta hai? UPI MDR explained in Hindi 🧾

Comment karo: fee lagni chahiye? Haan ya na. Aur us dost ko bhejo jo kehta hai 'UPI toh free hai'.

Merchant fee (MDR) abhi zero hai; kharcha banks aur apps uthate hain, sarkar incentive deti aayi hai (₹1,500 cr, FY25).
Rs 2000+ merchant payments pe 0.4% MDR announce hua, par NPCI ne rollout postpone kiya hai, naya date abhi nahi aaya.

Yeh explainer hai, financial advice nahi. Save karo interview ke liye.

scenes.question: Bill kaun bharta?
scenes.vo: दस रुपये की chai, UPI से. Fee zero. बिल कौन भरता है?

हर tap के पीछे app, NPCI का switch और banks चलते हैं.

scenes.title: MDR = 0
scenes.vo: Asli jawab: merchant fee, यानी MDR, अभी zero है.
Kharcha banks और apps उठाते हैं, सरकार incentive देती आई है.

scenes.label: merchant payments above
scenes.vo: Twist: ₹2000 से ऊपर के merchant payments पे 0.4% fee announce हुई.

scenes.label: status check

दोस्त को भेजना free. Fee लगी तो merchant भरेगा, आप नहीं.
